samples.content: On 1 February 2020, the Harbor Project Office issued a disclosure restriction. The restriction applied to Mina Lee's public statements and remained in effect through 7 February 2020. On 1 February 2020, Mina Lee, acting in her personal capacity, received and acknowledged the restriction.
On 3 February 2020, Mina Lee, acting in her personal capacity, held an internal briefing about the disclosure restriction. From 1 through 4 February 2020, Lee focused on internal preparation.

On 5 February 2020, Mina Lee, acting in her personal capacity, published a response. The response addressed questions raised in the internal briefing on 3 February. From 5 through 7 February 2020, Lee focused on public communication.
